card.name: Website footers, login prompts, and file notes
card.fires_on: Words and symbols inside web-page footers, login prompts and file-format notes, such as 'your' in a WordPress comment prompt or 'PDF' in a download note.

modes.label: Comment login prompts
modes.description: Words inside the repeated 'You are commenting using your ... account' text.

modes.label: PDF and file formats
modes.description: The format name PDF or .pdf in download or availability notes.

modes.label: Licence and code fragments
modes.description: Punctuation or small words in licence lines, error messages and markup.

card.plain: It fires on stock website text like comment-login lines, PDF notes and licence footers.
